items.headline: Rock Island fire chief to retire
items.summary: Bob Graff is retiring after working with the Rock Island Fire Department for 29 years.

items.headline: First-time mom nominates Trinity BirthPlace nurse for national award after reuniting her with newborn in NICU

items.headline: Pritzker pledges to stay on ‘Team Fight’ as he asks Illinois voters for 3rd term
